text: The Falkland Islands are a British Overseas Territory east of the Tierra del Fuego Province of Argentina. As such, for country streaks purposes, it is counted as the UK.
Coverage is very limited: there are only a couple of Generation 3 trekkers. The trekkers are all located on and around three islands in the western part of the territory:

Due to the sparse nature of the coverage, that is also entirely not on any streets, it is not useful to learn any territory identification metas. Instead, it is better to just memorise what the trekkers look like.
text_zh: 福克蘭群島是英國海外領土，位於阿根廷火地省以東。因此，出於國家連勝（country streaks）的目的，它被算作英國的一部分。
街景覆蓋非常有限：只有少數幾台第三代相機世代（Generation 3）徒步拍攝。這些徒步拍攝都位於該領土西部三個島嶼及其周邊：
由於覆蓋範圍稀疏，且完全不在任何街道上，因此學習任何領土識別特徵（meta）並沒有什麼用處。相反地，直接記住徒步拍攝的外觀會更好。

text: The Carcass Island trekker can be recognized by the **open plains**, with the ocean clearly visible. The ground may also get rocky.
NOTE: Do not get this confused with the Faroe Islands trekker.
text_zh: 卡卡斯島的徒步拍攝可以透過**開闊平原**來辨認，海洋清晰可見。地面也可能會變得多石。
注意：不要將其與法羅群島的徒步拍攝搞混了。

text: Open plains with **slightly yellow grass** can be seen on West Point Island. The ocean will not be clearly visible on this trekker.
text_zh: 在西波因特島上可以看到帶有**微黃草叢**的開闊平原。在這個徒步拍攝中，海洋將不會清晰可見。

text: This **boat trekker** can be seen in the West Point Bay, with yellow hills in the distance with the MS National Geographic Explorer in the bay with the trekker.
text_zh: 這個**船隻徒步拍攝**可以在西波因特灣（West Point Bay）看到，遠處有黃色的山丘，國家地理探險家號（MS National Geographic Explorer）郵輪則停泊在灣內與徒步拍攝同行。

text: This **sandy beach** with other people in red and blue jackets can be seen on New Island.
text_zh: 在新島可以看到這個帶有其他穿著紅藍夾克人們的**沙灘**。

text: Inland New Island can be recognized by the **dark brown soil**. Tire tracks may also be visible.
text_zh: 內陸的新島可以透過**深棕色土壤**來辨認。輪胎痕跡也可能清晰可見。

text: Distinct **steep cliffs** can be seen on New Island.
text_zh: 在新島上可以看到明顯的**陡峭懸崖**。
